candidates.citation: NV CR 25-16 (Douglas County — Lake Tahoe and tributaries)

parameters.note: North Logan House Creek is the northern branch of the Logan House Creek system on Lake Tahoe's east shore in Douglas County, Nevada; its mapped course descends west from the Carson Range and reaches the lake near Glenbrook Bay (OpenStreetMap way 1382632080, downstream terminus ~39.0694, -119.9422), so it is a Lake Tahoe tributary. It is not named individually in CR 25-16, so the applicable Douglas County listing is 'Lake Tahoe and tributaries' — open year around. It is NOT in Douglas County's closed-waters list (only Glenbrook Creek, from Lake Tahoe to Highway 50, and the Cave Rock boat-launch area, are closed), so it is open all year. That 'Lake Tahoe and tributaries' row (rather than the county's general 'All waters' row) governs Lake Tahoe's tributary streams, as confirmed by the parallel Washoe County treatment where specific Lake Tahoe tributary creeks (Third, Incline, Wood) are individually closed 'from Lake Tahoe to the Mt. Rose Highway.'

candidates.summary: Open year-round (Nevada / Douglas County 'Lake Tahoe and tributaries' listing; North Logan House Creek is a Lake Tahoe tributary and is not in the county's closed-waters list).

parameters.counting_rule: Douglas County 'Lake Tahoe and tributaries' limit: 5 game fish daily, 10 game fish in possession. 'Game fish' is the combined coldwater/warmwater game-fish count; no species sub-limit is listed for this row in CR 25-16.

candidates.summary: 5 game fish per day, 10 in possession (Nevada Douglas County 'Lake Tahoe and tributaries' limit).

candidates.citation: NV CR 25-16 (Douglas County — Lake Tahoe and tributaries)

parameters.note: The 'Lake Tahoe and tributaries' row carries restricted hours (1 hour before sunrise to 2 hours after sunset) — narrower than Douglas County's general 'All waters' rule of any hour of the day or night.

candidates.summary: Fishing permitted from 1 hour before sunrise to 2 hours after sunset.

parameters.note: A Nevada fishing license is required for anglers 12 and older. North Logan House Creek is a Nevada tributary (Douglas Co.), not the open water of Lake Tahoe; the Lake Tahoe CA/NV reciprocal-license arrangement is written for fishing anywhere ON the lake, so a Nevada license (not a California license alone) should be carried on the creek.

candidates.summary: A Nevada fishing license is required for anglers age 12 and older; none required under 12.
